text:
Alex J: Quick sync — NovaHealth POC kickoff request landed. They want a 2-week eval for a clinical triage assistant. High level asks: golden dataset of triage prompts, deterministic scoring, latency SLO 200ms p50, data residency + security questionnaire answers, and a pricing estimate for a small Dedicated pool. Can we scope?

Maria T: Thanks. Two-week sounds tight but doable if we scope narrowly. Proposed success criteria: (1) >=85% correctness on golden prompts; (2) avg latency p50 <=200ms on their sample load (70 rps burst profile); (3) no PII exfil in 1000 test traces; (4) regression gate defined. Agree? :white_check_mark:

Kevin S: Agree with criteria. For the golden dataset we should include: patient-symptom variants, ambiguous inputs, and adversarial phrasings. I'll draft 120 prompts: 80 normal, 20 ambiguous, 20 adversarial. Will add expected labels/acceptables.

Sophie L: On scoring: propose 3-stage scoring pipeline: (A) exact label match for closed answers, (B) semantic similarity threshold (sent-bert) for freeform, (C) safety filter (block if medical hallucination score > 0.6). Example pseudocode for similarity check:

```
# pseudo
sim = embed(resp) · embed(golden)
if sim > 0.78: pass
else: score -= (0.78 - sim)
```

Pranav R: Security Qs: they want answers to encryption at rest, KMS integration, audit logs, and bring-your-own-key. I'll attach our standard security FAQ and fill the specific NovaHealth fields. Also they asked about SOC2 / ISO status — we have SOC2 Type II in progress; will confirm exact status in template.

Alex J: Pricing question from buyer: what does a "small Dedicated pool" cost for 2-week POC with burst to 4 GPUs? They want a one-off estimate and a monthly committed price. Maria, can you draft a short price sheet?

Maria T: I can. My quick POC estimate: $6k for a 2-week small Dedicated (4xA800 equiv) with permissive burst; monthly committed price for production starts at ~$18k/mo (discounts at 3-6 months). I'll formalize.

Kevin S: Operational blockers: NovaHealth requires audit logs exported to their SIEM (Splunk). We need to confirm retention and whether we can stream logs to their VPC. If not, will propose S3 push + cross-account role.

Sophie L: For eval harness setup: plan to spin up a lightweight GH repo with tests, golden dataset, scoring script, and a harness runner that pushes requests to hosted endpoint and Dedicated endpoint for comparison. Minimal test harness outline:

- /golden/prompts.jsonl (120 entries)
- /scoring/score.py (runnable)
- /ci/run_eval.sh -> outputs CSV with fields: prompt_id, expected_label, model_resp, score, safety_flag

I can bootstrap in a day.

Alex J: timeline:
- Thu: send SQA + price sheet to buyer
- Fri: kickoff call + confirm golden prompt samples
- Mon (week 1): engineering drops harness and we run first pass on hosted models
- Wed (week 1): Dedicated env up, run parallel tests
- End of week 2: final report + pass/fail and next steps

Pranav R: I'll finish the SQA answers today and put in the shared google doc. Also confirm SOC2 status.

deploy-bot: POC sandbox provisioning started for novahealth-poc-1815. URL: https://sandbox.redwood.example/novahealth-poc-1815 (credentials via 1password).

Kevin S: For regression gates, suggest blocking release if: mean score across golden set drops >3 points vs baseline OR any safety_flag rate >1%. Thoughts?

Maria T: +1 to gate thresholds. For reporting, include per-category breakdown (normal / ambiguous / adversarial) and latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99).

Alex J: Good. Action items: Kevin -> golden prompts (sharing draft by EOD), Sophie -> bootstrap harness repo (PR link in thread), Maria -> price sheet + contract note, Pranav -> SQA doc. I'll run kickoff call invite for Fri 10am PT and loop in buyer SMEs.

Kevin S: Draft uploaded: https://gh.example/redwood/novahealth-poc/golden-prompts (please review).

Sophie L: PR created for harness: https://gh.example/redwood/novahealth-poc/harness/pull/3. Basic runner + scoring script included.

Alex J: Perfect. If anyone sees high-risk items (data residency, SIEM streaming), flag asap. Otherwise I'll send the buyer the scoped plan after the kickoff. :rocket:

Maria T: Sending price sheet and annotated SOW now.

Pranav R: SQA doc linked: https://docs.example/redwood/novahealth-sqa. Answered KMS and retention Qs.

Alex J: Thanks all. We'll update post-kickoff.
